scope: Keycloak password-grant and token-introspection smoke checks plus synthetic fixtures. Not browser SSO, a deployed vendor application, SCIM, or production certification.

results.question: Can the sample authenticate with the bundled identity provider?
results.answer: Yes. It obtains and introspects a token from the local Keycloak realm.
results.detail: Test user signed in. Token issuer http://localhost:8080/realms/customer, audience vendor-app, account

results.question: Can groups control the sample's authorization decisions?
results.answer: Yes. Test groups map to read and export permissions in the sample function.
results.detail: admin export: allowed; viewer read: allowed; viewer export: denied

results.question: Does disabling the test user block token requests and access?
results.answer: Yes. After disabling, new token requests fail and the sample rejects the old token.
results.detail: After disabling a test user: new token request blocked; previous token rejected by the sample authorization function

results.question: Is MFA enforced for privileged accounts?
results.detail: 11/12 privileged accounts with MFA (synthetic sign-in log sample, 2026-10-10). Exceptions: admin-07

results.question: Can we export audit logs?
results.answer: Yes, a daily export to customer storage.
results.detail: Evidence is 253 days old: 30/30 daily exports delivered (synthetic export job history, 2026-02-01)

results.question: Is customer data encrypted at rest?
results.detail: Nothing to check: attested only. Needs a document and human review.
